snippet.title: Off The Grid | Steam Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Off The Grid is available NOW on Steam.

Welcome to Off The Grid, the next-gen free to play Battle Royale from visionary director Neill Blomkamp. Set in a near-future world where contestants are cybernetically augmented and dropped into televised bloodsport. Death is temporary, but fame is forever.

Download on Steam: https://otg.gg/steam

--------
